note: Hand-tuned rates. Entries here replace the generated rate for that activity, and catalogue:build never touches this file. Same shape as entries in the other rate files.

rates.source: hand-tuned 2026-11-25: blocks/min x 3-5 Rough per block x (1 + 79 x Pristine/100) x (1 + (Mining + Gemstone Fortune)/100) (wiki Gemstone, Pristine). Mid ~40-80 blocks/min, Pristine 2-5, fortune 100-300; one measured session gave 1,721/min (~77 blocks/min). The generic mining-collection default (150-500) ignored base drops and Pristine.
